# SynapseKit

> Async-native Python framework for building production-grade LLM applications. RAG pipelines, ReAct agents, graph workflows, and AgentFederation — with only 2 hard dependencies and no lock-in. Apache 2.0.

## Overview

SynapseKit is an open-source Python library that replaces heavyweight LLM frameworks like LangChain with a minimal, async-first design. It provides composable building blocks for RAG, agents, and graph-based workflows.

- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseKit/SynapseKit
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/synapsekit/
- Website: https://synapse-kit.com
- License: Apache 2.0
- Current version: 1.9.1
- Hard dependencies: numpy, rank-bm25 (only 2)

## Key Capabilities

- **RAG Pipelines** — 53 document loaders, 11 vector stores, hybrid BM25+vector search, reranking
- **ReAct Agents** — function calling, 47+ built-in tools, episodic+semantic memory, 4 backends
- **Graph Workflows** — DAG-based pipelines, parallel branches, conditional routing, recursive subgraphs
- **AgentFederation** — distributed agent routing with in-memory or Redis registry
- **33 LLM Providers** — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, xAI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and 23 more
- **EvalCI** — GitHub Action for LLM evaluation on every pull request
- **Async-native** — every API is async/await by default; sync wrappers available
- **Cost tracking** — built-in, no SaaS required

## Installation

```
pip install synapsekit
pip install synapsekit[openai]
pip install synapsekit[all]
uv add synapsekit
```

## Architecture

Six composable layers (top to bottom):
1. Application Layer — scripts, FastAPI, Jupyter notebooks
2. Tools & CLI — CLI commands, PromptHub, 47+ tools
3. Core Orchestration — RAGPipeline, Agent, StateGraph, AgentFederation
4. Data & Memory — 53 loaders, 11 stores, hybrid search, 9 memory backends
5. LLM Providers — 33 providers, one BaseLLM interface
6. Async Core — numpy + rank-bm25 only

## Comparison vs LangChain / LlamaIndex

| Feature | SynapseKit | LangChain | LlamaIndex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hard dependencies | 2 | 50+ | 20+ |
| Async-native | Yes | Partial | Partial |
| Cost tracking | Built-in | SaaS add-on | No |
| Agent federation | Yes | No | No |
| License | Apache 2.0 | MIT | MIT |
